title: Chemical reactions 2 - 123 school
heading: Chemical reactions 2
intro: Test your knowledge by typing your answer and comparing it with the correct answer. Then click 'Check answers'.

questions.q: What are starting substances (reactants)?
questions.a: The substances that react with each other (left of the arrow)

questions.q: What are reaction products?
questions.a: The substances that are formed (right of the arrow)

questions.q: Name three observations that can indicate a chemical reaction
questions.a: Colour change, gas being produced, precipitate, change of smell, temperature change, light

questions.q: Is melting ice a chemical reaction? Explain.
questions.a: No. No new substance is formed (only a different state).

questions.q: Which two things stay the same in a chemical reaction?
questions.a: The number of atoms of each type and the total mass

questions.q: What is step 1 of the step-by-step method for a reaction equation?
questions.a: Write down the reaction scheme in words

questions.q: What is step 2 of the step-by-step method for a reaction equation?
questions.a: Write down the reaction scheme in molecular formulae

questions.q: What is step 3 of the step-by-step method for a reaction equation?
What is step 4 of the step-by-step method for a reaction equation?
What may you change when balancing a reaction equation?
questions.a: Only the numbers in front of the formulae (coefficients). Not the small numbers inside the formulae.

What do (s), (l), (g) and (aq) after a formula mean?
questions.a: (s) solid, (l) liquid, (g) gas, (aq) dissolved in water

questions.q: What is decomposition?
questions.a: Splitting a substance into two or more other substances

questions.q: What is a synthesis?
questions.a: Making one new substance from two or more substances

questions.q: What is it called when a substance is decomposed using electric current?
Give the reaction equation for the decomposition of water
What is combustion?
questions.a: A reaction of a substance with oxygen

questions.q: Which three things do you need for combustion?
questions.a: Fuel, oxygen and a high enough temperature

questions.q: Which substances are formed in the complete combustion of a hydrocarbon?
Which substances can be formed in incomplete combustion?
What is a precipitate?
questions.a: A solid that forms in a solution

You mix a solution of silver nitrate with a solution of sodium chloride. Silver chloride does not dissolve in water. What do you see?
questions.a: A white precipitate of silver chloride

questions.q: How do you test for oxygen?
questions.a: A glowing splint burns more brightly

questions.q: How do you test for carbon dioxide?
How do you test for hydrogen gas?
questions.a: With a burning splint: you hear a squeaky pop
